preamble: Phone call between Meena (the hirer, who is paying for a job) and Worker (the worker, who will do it). Gawah is an AI witness listening on the call. Today is Saturday 21 November 2026. Amounts are in Indian rupees.

questions.work_agreed: Have both speakers agreed on what work is to be done (the scope of the job)? Answer yes only if one person has described the work and the other has accepted it.
questions.amount_agreed: Have both speakers agreed on the total price for the whole job? Answer yes only if one final total amount has been accepted by both. An offer or counter-offer that the other person has not accepted is not an agreement.
questions.advance_agreed: Have both speakers agreed on an advance payment amount (money paid before the work starts)? Answer yes only if both have accepted the same advance amount.
questions.balance_when: Have both speakers agreed on when the remaining balance (the total minus the advance) will be paid? Answer yes only if a specific time or condition for paying the balance was stated and accepted. If the question was asked but brushed aside or not answered, answer no.
questions.dates_agreed: Have both speakers agreed on both the start date and the finish date of the work?
questions.late_terms: Have the speakers agreed on what happens if the work is finished late or left unfinished, such as a penalty, a deduction or a refund? A promise to finish on time is not enough; answer yes only if a consequence was agreed.
questions.addressed_gawah: In the last line of the transcript, is the speaker talking directly to Gawah, the AI witness, for example by calling it by name?
questions.topic_left_unclear: Is there a contract term (price, advance, when the balance is paid, or dates) that one speaker asked about, where the other speaker has already replied without giving a clear answer and moved on to a different topic? A question in the last line that the other speaker has not yet had a chance to answer does not count. Answer yes only if that term is still unsettled.
questions.conflicting_figures: Has a figure that both speakers had already accepted (for example the total price or the advance) later been stated as a different number for that same term? Answer no for bargaining: an offer, a counter-offer, or a lower or higher number proposed before both speakers accepted is not a conflict.
questions.wrapping_up: Is the call ending right now? Answer yes only if, in the last two lines, a speaker says goodbye, says they are hanging up, or thanks the other person to close the conversation. Agreeing to a term (for example 'theek hai', 'pakka', 'done') or promising to finish the work on time is not ending the call.
questions.balance_skipped: Have the speakers agreed on an advance and then started talking about a different subject, such as the dates of the work or what happens if it is late, without anyone saying when the remaining balance will be paid? Answer no if when the balance is paid has been agreed, if no advance has been agreed yet, or if the speakers are still talking about payments.
questions.closing_soon: Have the speakers finished discussing the terms and started closing the conversation, for example by confirming when and where they will meet next, thanking each other, or saying goodbye? Answer no while a price, a payment, a date or any other term is still being discussed.

lines.1: Meena: Vijay bhaiya, bedroom mein ek wardrobe banwana hai, floor se ceiling tak.
lines.2: Worker: Ban jayega didi. Kitna chauda chahiye?
lines.3: Meena: Saat foot chauda, teen darwaze, andar do drawer.
lines.4: Worker: Theek hai, saat foot ka teen door wardrobe, do drawer ke saath, plywood aur laminate mera. Yeh pakka.
lines.5: Meena: Gawah, yeh sab record ho raha hai na?
lines.6: Worker: Haan didi, ho raha hoga. Toh kaam ka 60 hazaar lagega.
lines.7: Meena: Bahut zyada hai. 50 mein karo.
lines.8: Worker: 50 mein nahi padta didi, 55 last.
lines.9: Meena: Chalo theek hai, 55 hazaar. Kaam kab tak poora hoga?
lines.10: Worker: Jaldi kar denge didi, aap chinta mat karo. Advance 20 hazaar bhej dena aaj.
lines.11: Meena: 20 theek hai, aaj shaam ko bhej dungi. Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad.
lines.12: Worker: Haan didi, baaki 35 kaam khatam hone par de dena.
lines.13: Meena: Theek hai. Toh 20 advance aur total 50, sahi hai na?
lines.14: Worker: Ji didi. Kal subah aata hoon naap lene.
lines.15: Meena: Theek hai bhaiya, kal milte hain. Thank you.
